samples_manifest.description: Fixed sample seeds for card I-02-A. All layouts are generated deterministically by scripts/w02a_cases.py per case into a short-commented scratch base; bytes are the frozen contract payload.

layouts.p1: company_raw root (company_raw_v1) + archive_extra root (sidecar_filing_v1, healthy unrelated .txt+.source.json); target staged under catalog staging
layouts.n1: company_raw only; scanner-level seam failure injected (errors=1, files_seen=0)
layouts.n2: company_raw with an unrelated healthy company (别家公司, PAYLOAD_B+sidecar) and harness filtering hides the target from the scan (errors=0, files_seen>0)
layouts.n3a: company_raw only; scan_root_strategy raises RuntimeError mid-writer-rescan (interrupted)
layouts.n3b: company_raw healthy + archive_extra failing via injection; direct scanner scan over both roots
layouts.n3c: company_raw only; real scan registers the target; fabricated resolver returns reused_exact on an unrelated handle

samples_manifest.isolation: each case: fresh rmtree + mkdir; isolated sqlite (catalog.sqlite3), staging dir, no network, no production DB
